group.title: Intelligence Settings
group.description: Store API keys and default assists for your tenant.

global-ai.title: Global AI Settings
global-ai.description: Default assist and system-wide instructions for AI chat.

gemini.title: Google Gemini
gemini.description: Configure the Google Gemini API key.

name.title: Default Assist
name.description: Pick an assist from the list. If none is selected, the assist named platform-assistant is used when it exists.

prefix.title: System Instruction
prefix.description: Prepended when non-empty; assist and agent prompts follow.
prefix.placeholder: e.g. Always follow company policy X. Never disclose internal IDs.

api-key.title: API Key
api-key.description: Your Google AI Studio API key for Gemini.

api-base.title: API Base URL
api-base.description: OpenAI-compatible base: full chat completions URL, or origin ending with /v1, or host only. Used for chat and derived image URL when model purpose is image.

api-key.title: API Key
api-key.description: Bearer token sent to this endpoint (store only trusted values).

stream.title: Stream Chat Completions
stream.description: When enabled, uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming. Turn off for local providers that mishandle streaming or when you need a single JSON response for debugging.

max-context-tokens.title: Max Context (Tokens)
max-context-tokens.description: Total context window size for this model (input + output budget).

max-output-tokens.title: Max Output (Tokens)
max-output-tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may return in a single completion.

max-input-tokens.title: Max Input (Tokens)
max-input-tokens.description: Typical cap on user and history tokens per request (often near context minus reserved output).

input-price-per-million.title: Input Price (per 1M Tokens)
input-price-per-million.description: USD per 1 million input tokens (reference pricing for estimation).

output-price-per-million.title: Output Price (per 1M Tokens)
output-price-per-million.description: USD per 1 million output tokens (reference pricing for estimation).

cached-input-price-per-million.title: Cached Input Price (per 1M Tokens)
cached-input-price-per-million.description: USD per 1 million cached prompt tokens. Leave blank to use the regular input price.

open-ai-endpoint.title: OpenAI Endpoint
open-ai-endpoint.description: Required when chat transport is OpenAI-compatible. Ignored for Gemini.

open-ai-endpoint-is-disabled.title: OpenAI Endpoint Disabled (System)
open-ai-endpoint-is-disabled.description: True when the linked OpenAI endpoint is disabled. Updated automatically; when true, the model cannot be enabled until the endpoint is enabled.

api-model-id.title: API Model ID
api-model-id.description: Exact model string sent to the provider (e.g. gpt-4o, gemini-2.5-flash). Shown as the technical name in lists.

model-purpose.title: Model Purpose
model-purpose.description: Chat models for the Assist catalog; image models use AiManagement:ChatGenerateImage; speech-to-text uses AiManagement:ChatTranscribeSpeech; text-to-speech uses AiManagement:ChatSynthesizeSpeech.

model-purposes.title: Model Capabilities
model-purposes.description: One model can combine several capabilities (e.g. chat + vision + speech). Tags are colored in lists; pick from suggestions when editing.

command-registry.title: Commands
command-registry.description: Add one row per command definition this assist may call directly in the same session. Set default argument values from the registry input schema; the model can override them per call.

query-registry.title: Queries
query-registry.description: Add one row per query definition this assist may call directly in the same session. Default input values are merged with the model's arguments at fetch time (model wins on conflicts).

mcp-servers.title: MCP Servers
mcp-servers.description: External MCP servers whose tools are exposed to this assist in the same session.

output-contract.title: Output Contract
output-contract.description: JSON object: kind (string | object | array), optional transcriptSegment (when object), instruction, schema, schemaSummary, validationCommandName, structuredRetries. Default supervisor output contract for this assist; overridden per agent or per run.

planning-mode.title: Planning Mode
planning-mode.description: When to run one tool-free planning turn before the model may call tools. End users do not change this; it is configured per assist.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Reusable system-prompt fragments from the Rules catalog (merged on each engine run). Display title; engine resolves by rule name.

knowledge-files.title: Knowledge Files
knowledge-files.description: Upload PDF documents or images to extend this assist's knowledge base.

starter-prompts.title: Starter Prompts
starter-prompts.description: Optional suggested first messages (per locale) users can pick when starting a chat with this assist.

has-access-to-all-tools.title: Access to All Tools and Query

model.title: Chat Model
model.description: The AI model catalog row used for supervisor assist runs (end users do not pick a model in chat).

available-agents.title: Available Agents
available-agents.description: Add one row per AI agent this assist may delegate to. Set assist-locked and assist-default values per agent (see each agent’s parameter definitions). Reorder rows as needed.

prompt.title: Prompt & Initial Messages
prompt.validation-invalid-json: Initial messages must be valid JSON array.

command-registry.title: Commands
command-registry.description: Add one row per command definition the specialist may run. Set default argument values from the registry input schema; the model can override them per call.

query-registry.title: Queries
query-registry.description: Add one row per query definition the specialist may use. Default input values are merged with the model’s arguments at fetch time (model wins on conflicts).

description.description: Short summary for lists and search. Full supervisor routing is built from the Supervisor Delegation fields below.

supervisor-when-to-use.title: When to delegate
supervisor-when-to-use.description: Plain text for the supervisor LLM (not localized). Merged into the delegated tool description at runtime.

supervisor-when-not-to-use.title: When not to delegate
supervisor-when-not-to-use.description: Intents where the supervisor must not call this specialist (e.g. greetings for current-time).

supervisor-chains-with.title: Chaining hints
supervisor-chains-with.description: Optional order with other specialists (e.g. platform-entity first, then widget-form-layout).

supervisor-intent-tags.title: Intent tags
supervisor-intent-tags.description: Optional keywords for admin filtering; also appended to the supervisor tool description.

model-entity.title: Default Model
model-entity.description: Optional. When set, this agent will use this catalog model instead of the user’s chat model (must still be allowed by the assist).

max-steps.title: Max Tool Rounds
max-steps.description: Maximum provider rounds inside this specialist run (default 5, max 50).

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Reusable system-prompt fragments from the Rules catalog (merged on each engine run). Display title; engine resolves by rule name.

parameter-definitions.title: Supervisor Parameters
parameter-definitions.description: Array of parameter definitions: each object has name, binding (supervisor | assist_locked | assist_default), and optional title, description, defaultValue. Leave empty for a single required string argument `query`. assist_locked values come from the assist row; assist_default fills missing supervisor args from the assist map; supervisor fields are filled by the supervisor model.

output-contract.title: Output Contract
output-contract.description: Transcript segment preset for the specialist’s final message on delegated runs. Options come from registered segment providers. Leave empty for default string (prose/Markdown) replies.

kind.title: Output Kind
kind.description: JSON data primitive for the final deliverable: string (prose/Markdown text), object (JSON object), or array (JSON array). The engine builds system prompts and post-processing from this value.

transcript-segment.title: Transcript Segment
transcript-segment.description: When kind is object: how the parsed JSON is mapped into chat transcript. text = generic JSON as text; node = inner AXPWidgetNode wrapped as chat node; followUp = suggestion chips envelope.

instruction.title: Output Instruction
instruction.placeholder: e.g. Prefer block-layout root for chat tables.
instruction.description: Optional domain-specific rules merged after engine output-contract defaults. Do not repeat kind, validation command, or envelope shape here — the engine injects those automatically.

schema-summary.title: Schema Summary
schema-summary.description: Short natural-language hint about the expected JSON shape. Shown in the system prompt and in retry messages when validation fails. Example: Root block-layout with mode view; children are form-field rows.

schema-name.title: Provider Schema Name
schema-name.description: Label for the JSON schema when using provider json_schema response format. Example: FormLayoutOutput.

schema-strict.title: Strict JSON Schema
schema-strict.description: When enabled, asks the model provider to enforce the JSON schema strictly where supported (e.g. OpenAI structured outputs).

structured-retries.title: Structured Retries
structured-retries.description: How many extra model turns to run after parse or validation failure (0–10). Default is 2 when empty. Example: 3 for widget node agents.

validation-command-name.title: Validation Command
validation-command-name.description: Registry command the agent must call before the final widget JSON (object + transcript segment node). Example: AiFormbuilder:ValidateLayoutJsonForAi — when data.valid is true, the final text must be data.normalizedJson.

provider-format-type.title: Provider Response Format
provider-format-type.description: Override the provider-native structured output hint. Leave empty to derive from kind (e.g. json_object for object/array). Use json_schema when you need strict schema binding.

provider-format-name.title: Provider Schema Name Override
provider-format-name.description: Schema name sent to the provider when Provider Response Format is json_schema. Example: ChartLayoutOutput.

provider-format-strict.title: Provider Strict Mode
provider-format-strict.description: When enabled with json_schema format, turns on the provider’s strict schema mode where supported.

name.description: Programmatic key referenced from assists, agents, and engine run options (e.g. markdown).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Text merged into the system prompt when this rule is included.

errors.invalid-api-key: The speech service rejected the API key. Check the endpoint key under Intelligence → OpenAI Endpoints.
errors.rate-limited: The speech service is busy. Please try again in a moment.
errors.provider-unavailable: Speech is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.extract-document-text-failed: Could not read the document. Try again or fill the fields yourself.
errors.generate-image-failed: Could not generate the image. Try again.
errors.transcribe-speech-failed: Could not transcribe the audio. Try again.
errors.synthesize-speech-failed: Could not generate speech. Try again.
